title: Your subjects
intro: For each subject you only need two things: the course and the final internal mark your school reported. Add your rank if you know it. Task-by-task marks, exam marks and course settings are all optional — open them only if you want more detail.
noneBody: Choose your first course below and enter the final internal mark your school reported. That's all the calculator needs to start.

card.fromTasks: Worked out from your task marks.
card.untilTask: Used until a task mark is complete.

tasks.note: Task names are optional. For each task, enter its weight and either the score and total or just the percentage. As soon as one task is complete, the internal mark is worked out for you.
tasks.pctTitle: Use this instead of score and total

exam.note: Optional. These are the same marks as the sliders and the ATAR boxes on the calculator page — change them in either place.
exam.whatIfHelp: Linked to the sliders and the graph.

settings.note: Filled in automatically from the course list. Only change these if you know the details are different.
settings.anchorNote: Blended HSC mark → scaled mark out of 100. See every course side by side on the How it works page.

add.label: Add a subject
add.searchPlaceholder: Start typing — e.g. chem, maths, Japanese
add.hint: Type to search, arrows to choose, Enter to add.

optional.summary: Optional settings — your name and the moderation estimate
optional.name: Student name
optional.modToggle: Adjust internal marks by rank and cohort level
optional.modHelp: Needs a rank and class size for a subject. Subjects without them use the mark as entered.
optional.levelHelp: How strong your school's cohort is expected to be in the HSC exams.
optional.spreadHelp: How far apart your cohort's exam marks sit. 10 is a typical default.
